Dear Miss Yonge	
There are three aspects of [illegible] [Miss Bonham Carter](../persons.html#1913), not [illegible] is the artist. [I](../persons.html#939) saw it in his studio and concluded it was his own.

Of course we can only [engrave](../others.html#167) one of the three. I think unquestionably the one looking to the right.[^1]
Please tell me how you like it

Yours ever truly
A.

Macmillan

[^1]: Probably portraits of Florence Nightingale that Macmillan was proposing for the title page vignette in [A Book of Golden Deeds](../books.html#51).

The Bonham-Carters were [Florence Nightingale](../persons.html#1086)’s cousins
